# Jarrod Tran

Jarrod Tran is Head of Strategic Planning and Special Projects for Tesla Energy Megapack in Houston, Texas.

He works on capacity, cost, and special projects: getting finance and operations onto one plan.

Previously: Apple (Senior Strategic Operations Program Manager, iPhone India launch), Waymo (Strategy & BizOps Manager, Engineering), Tesla Special Projects (4680 launch and Fremont planning), Amazon (Operations Area Manager).

Selected outcomes:
- Tesla Energy: 3.2× capacity scale (14.7 to 46.7 GWh), $260M annualized savings, $156M incremental annual profit from a $23M capacity portfolio.
- Apple iPhone India: 293% year-over-year unit growth (4.3M to 16.9M), revenue $2B to $10B, exports from 6 to 40+ countries.

Education: B.S. Business Administration, Finance, University at Buffalo, Cum Laude.
